message:
fix(ext/http): extract traceparent from Deno.serve regardless of header name case (#36840)

Header names on the HTTP/1 fast path in `Deno.serve` reach the
propagator carrier verbatim from the wire, so a request with
`Traceparent:` (or any non-lowercase spelling) was silently ignored and
the server span started a fresh trace instead of joining the caller's.
HTTP/2 was unaffected because hyper already normalises header names
there.

The fix just lowercases the names when building the carrier array. The
new spec test sends a raw HTTP/1.1 request over TCP, since `fetch`
lowercases header names itself and can't reproduce this.
